title: Presence Sensor
description: A presence sensor reporting whether a space is occupied, with a running count of detections.

isPresent.description: Whether presence is currently detected in the monitored space.

lastDetection.description: Timestamp of the most recent presence change.

presence.title: Presence Detected
presence.description: Fires when presence is detected, carrying the running detection count.

absence.title: Absence Detected
absence.description: Fires when the space becomes empty, carrying how long presence lasted.
